linen.notes: Threshold-based clean-linen trolley exchange. Trolley contents deplete at the corresponding Linen waste-generation rate. Where one linen receiving area serves several departments sharing a waste location, their Linen waste rates are aggregated.

D8.notes: No Linen waste stream is configured for D8; the established standard rate was used: 32 events/day × 0.02 m³ = 0.64 m³/day.

D1.notes: Clean-linen trolley replenishment at 0.8 m³ threshold; depletion 0.64 m³/day, matching each department linen-waste rate.
